observations: Three photos show large stacks of used tires leaning against a wall/doorway, apparently in a tire shop or warehouse.
Tread patterns differ between tires in the stacks, suggesting a mixed lot of different brands/models rather than a single matching set.
No sidewall text, size markings, or brand names are legible in any photo.
No wheel rim is visible in any of the three photos, despite the seller mentioning 'rim'.
Tires show visible wear, some cracking on sidewalls, and dust/dirt consistent with used/second-hand stock.
Watermarks ('POSTED ON JIJI', 'IKWE ANTHONY') overlay the images; these are platform/seller marks, not product information.

identity.kind: used car tires (tyre stock, size/brand unreadable)

claims.evidence: No country-of-origin marking, DOT code, or brand text is legible in photo 0, 1, or 2; 'Belgium' is also a common trade term in Nigeria for used European-import tires, not a verifiable fact from the image.
No rim/wheel is visible in photo 0, photo 1, or photo 2 — only stacked tires are shown.

risks.risk: Actual tire size (rim diameter, width, profile) is unknown, which strongly affects value.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of a sidewall showing the size code (e.g., 205/55R16) on the specific tire(s) being sold.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the low end for an unspecified/common used tire size

risks.risk: Tread depth and real wear level cannot be judged precisely from a distance/stack shot.
risks.proof: Close-up of tread with a depth gauge or coin showing groove depth on each tire offered.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily worn, near end-of-life

risks.risk: Age of tires (manufacture date) unknown; old rubber can be unsafe even with tread.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the DOT date code on the sidewall.

risks.risk: It is unclear which exact tires (how many, which size/model) are included in this specific listing versus just being general shop inventory.
risks.proof: A photo or video singling out the specific set of tires (and rim, if included) that will be sold to the buyer.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single generic used tire, not a matched set, and rim excluded

risks.risk: No rim is shown despite being mentioned in the title.
risks.proof: A photo clearly showing the rim(s) included in the sale.
risks.if_unproven: priced as tires only, no rim included

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the sidewall size/DOT code on the actual tire(s) for sale
Photo of the rim(s) claimed to be included
Photo showing tread depth with a gauge or coin
Confirmation of exact quantity and whether it's a matched set or mixed
response.reason: The photos show only a generic stack of mixed used tires with no legible size, brand, or age markings, and no rim is visible despite being claimed; the size code that would set even a worst-case price cannot be read from any image.
